title: galium rotundifolium subsp. ellipticum
intro: Galium rotundifolium subsp. ellipticum, commonly known as Round-leaved Bedstraw, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties that aid in relieving digestive issues and reducing pain. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to relax muscles, reduce fever, and soothe respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Galium rotundifolium subsp. ellipticum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
